phases.objective: Keep the canonical tenant-request inbox readable across legacy utf8mb4 collation drift while introducing a bounded alignment migration for inbox-owned identity columns.

e2e_journeys.actor: platform admin or authenticated tenant member
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Ticket, latest lifecycle activity, and the latest resolution case are resolved without ER_CANT_AGGREGATE_2COLLATIONS and without weakening tenant scope.
steps: Normalize cross-table tenant_id, ticket_id, and ticket resource identity expressions to utf8mb4_unicode_ci inside the canonical inbox SQL builders.
Retain bounded candidate discovery and latest-activity ordering.
Align tenant_resolution_cases and ticket_lifecycle_events identity columns through a separately governed migration source.
Keep the legacy tickets table unchanged until a whole ticket-domain collation audit can recollate every dependent ticket_* family together.
assertions: No raw resolution-case-to-ticket tenant_id or ticket_id equality remains in the inbox builders.
No raw ticket_lifecycle_events-to-tickets tenant_id or ticket_id equality remains in candidate or latest-activity joins.
The migration pins inbox-owned identity columns to utf8mb4_unicode_ci without dropping or deleting data.
The migration is source-only in this PR and is not applied to Production.
